placeBlurb: A dramatic seasonal wadi high in the Hajar Mountains below Jebel Jais — red-rock walls, terraced pools and clear mountain air. The range that gives the northern Emirates their skyline.
skyCopy: The scale runs from remote desert to inner city. Up in the Hajar the sky opens up properly at night — and the mountain air gets cool enough that a heavyweight tee earns its keep.
designIntro: A topographic map is just a mountain described in lines. This design takes that language literally — the peaks on the front reduced to contour lines, the rock itself carried across the back.

printCardBody: Direct-to-garment printing sits in the fabric rather than on top of it, so the graphic stays soft and the cotton stays breathable — no plastic panel on your back.
fitExtra: If you plan to layer this one, the Regular fit sits better under a jacket.
careIntro: Nothing unusual — but these five habits are what keep a DTG print crisp and the cotton soft.
care: Machine wash cold, inside out — heat is what fades a print fastest.
Wash with similar colours, on a gentle cycle.
Hang to dry. Tumble drying is the main cause of shrinkage and cracking.
Do not iron directly on the print — iron inside out if you need to.
Skip bleach and fabric softener; softener coats the fibres and dulls the finish.

faq.q: Is the print going to crack?
faq.a: DTG ink bonds into the cotton rather than sitting on top as a thick layer, so it flexes with the fabric instead of cracking. Washing cold and hanging to dry — rather than tumble drying — is what makes the difference long term.

faq.q: Are these unisex? Will they fit women?
faq.a: Yes — every piece we make is cut unisex, in one run of sizes from S to XL. There is no separate men's or women's version and no difference in the cut. Because the size chart lists the garment measured flat rather than a body size, the reliable way to choose is to measure a t-shirt you already like the fit of and match the numbers. Plenty of people size down for a closer fit or up for a relaxed one — both are the same garment.
The fabric is pre-washed to minimise shrinkage. Wash cold and hang dry and you should see very little movement. Hot washes and tumble dryers are what cause shrinkage.

faq.q: Does this one work for layering?
faq.a: That is what it was designed for. The topographic front is the most neutral graphic in the collection, so it sits under an overshirt or jacket without competing. In the Regular fit it layers cleanly; the Oversized is better worn on its own.

faq.q: What if I order the wrong size?
faq.a: Exchanges within the UAE are free, subject to stock, within 14 days of delivery — as long as it's unworn, unwashed and still has tags. Email hello@sahraandbeyond.ae with your order number and we'll arrange it.
This is a limited first run. We may make more of a design later, but we don't promise it — when a size sells out in this run, treat it as gone.

fitWho: Take your normal t-shirt size. Regular is the one to choose if you layer under a shacket or jacket, if you run warm, or if you want the design to sit flat across the chest and back rather than drape. The shoulder seam lands where your shoulder actually ends.
